name: student-attendance-system
description: Student Attendance Management System - React + Vite frontend, Express + PostgreSQL backend
author: Anthony Granston

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
